ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (dark) pixels concentrated in the central region and 35% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation mass extending from the peduncle attachment across the central fluke; high-contrast white/grey regions at outer lobes containing irregular dark mottling and vertical streaks (0.1 to 0.3 lobe width on the right lobe).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible angle of approximately 105 degrees; depth occupies roughly 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-frequency serration across the trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly at the outer 15% of the lobe margins, resulting in jagged distal boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric upward sweep from the median notch with a slight convex curve visible along the mid-span of the trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark vertical linear pixel clusters on the right lobe's high-intensity zone; smaller, unaligned linear disruptions on the lower-left lobe boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged notch on the far left lobe tip trailing edge, distinct from natural serration patterns.
